limitations: One already reviewed, expired queued row and one final admission boundary. Known owner changes pause without asking a strict host to confirm the retired identity; equal owners still require a fresh final fence.

Conformance checks the real Java coordinator and journal against controlled owner, clock, storage, provider and scheduler ports. A failed final fence pauses Calendar without effects and keeps a reminder queued until a later authenticated owner change pauses it. Repeated reconciliation cannot repeat effects.

Full storage/process races, all retry-window states, Undo, provider uncertainty and installed Android behavior remain outside this projection. No global liveness or complete state coverage is claimed.
